snippet.title: Jetpack Birdie - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for Jetpack Birdie, a jetpack bullet-time action game developed by Alexey Kuleshov. Players will take the fight for freedom to the skies with the use of jetpacks. Make use of an array of weapons and abilities in Jetpack Birdie, launching in September 2025 for PC (Steam).
